---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for Rufio
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the use case. *"I'm trying to do X, and Rufio currently doesn't let me ___."*

**Proposed solution**
What would the ideal behaviour look like? Include CLI examples if relevant:

```bash
rufio <command> --new-flag=...
```

**Alternatives considered**
What workarounds have you tried? Why aren't they sufficient?

**Where does this fit?**
- [ ] v1 (current target — must justify why it can't wait)
- [ ] v1.1 (immediately after v1 launch)
- [ ] v1.2-1.5 (cloud / governance / advanced primitives)
- [ ] v2 (substrate self-observation, federation, marketplace)
- [ ] Not sure

**Reference**
Have you read [`docs/roadmap.md`](../docs/roadmap.md)? Is your request already there?
